pulse.currentFocus: S293 gave the production edge incident a measurable duration and published it. An append-only semantic ledger records only route-meaning changes and measures incidents against the last observation, so the live 0/5 route mismatch now reads as 13.3 days open, bounded by the independent uptime ledger and labelled as an upper bound rather than a claimed onset. The evidence graph gained human and agent projections plus three structural gates: declared checks must actually execute, a derived feed cannot ship without its ledger, and the /status/ renderer may only read fields its feed publishes. Production remains held and untouched.
pulse.nextMilestone: Restore Supabase SQL/Function authority and complete the real-provider identity ceremony, then rerun the release gate and restore/promote the production Worker only on all-green evidence — and verify the incident-close path against that real recovery.
blockers: The Supabase authority receipt is 1/4 ready: REST is HTTP 200, while management API, SQL migration, and Edge Function authority need an approved token or database/function credential through the secrets gateway.

The archive migration and Eternal Intelligence update are not deployed; authenticated Archive/Eternal tests and a real-provider Obelisk callback/session/member/investor/revocation journey must pass before production promotion.

Production Worker /v/rum has been stale since the 2026-07-03 out-of-band clobber, so RUM telemetry ingest is dark (last data 2026-07-02). As of S293 the degradation is measured, not just asserted: all 5 expected route contracts have been unmatched for at least 13.3 days (onset no later than 2026-07-12T23:52:39Z, corroborated by data/uptime-history.ndjson), and it is published on /status/. The canonical redeploy (gh workflow run cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml -f confirm_production=true) is founder-gated behind the fail-closed production promotion hold — restore requires clearing or explicitly accepting that hold.

now: [S293→NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Incident-close verification. The ledger has only ever recorded an open incident. When production is restored, assert the close path end-to-end on real data — `matched` flip appends exactly one row, the incident gains a `closedAt`, duration freezes, and `/status/` returns to the "no open incidents" state. Self-tested today with synthetic rows; unproven against a real recovery.

[S293→NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Onset corroboration beyond one coarse probe. `onsetNotLaterThan` currently tightens against `data/uptime-history.ndjson` alone. Fold in the other independent committed ledgers (RUM ingest silence since 2026-07-02, CI/deploy history) to narrow the bound further — each must stay labelled with its own resolution, never merged into route-level evidence.
